title: Speccify Project Manifest v1
description: A project's speccify.yaml: which playbooks it depends on and where local ones live. Version 1 is a clean restart alongside the playbook schema — no targets, no workspaces.

dependencies.description: Playbook id or git source -> version range (exact or caret).

sources.description: Further skill sources: git URLs (cloned by the app to ~/.speccify/sources/) or directories relative to this file.
